headlines.title: Is GE Vernova Stock a Buy After Its 25.2% Six-Month Rally?
headlines.summary: GEV's strong orders, rising gas turbine demand and expanding manufacturing capacity are driving growth, but its premium valuation may warrant caution.

headlines.title: Does AirJoule Technologies (AIRJ) Using GE Vernova’s Campus Showcase Reframe Its Industrial Water Strategy?
headlines.summary: In July 2026, AirJoule Technologies Corporation deployed its AirJoule Core atmospheric water generation system at GE Vernova’s new Advanced Research Center Frontier Campus in Niskayuna, New York, where it now operates as a live showcase producing distilled water directly from air for visiting customers and partners.

headlines.title: General Electric (GE) Sits 21% Above Fair Value Following Its Recent Pullback
headlines.summary: General Electric (GE) is back in focus after GE Vernova, its former energy division, reported a US$176b backlog and a recent 5% share price pullback following weaker adjusted EBITDA and EPS. See our latest analysis for General Electric. At a latest share price of US$370.08, General Electric has seen a 90 day share price return of 24.54% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 35.25%.

headlines.title: GE Vernova Holds an $176 Billion Backlog, Yet Wall Street Is Selling: What Investors Should Know.

headlines.title: AirJoule Technologies (AIRJ) Lands GE Vernova Showcase As Investors Weigh Its Undervalued Narrative
headlines.summary: AirJoule Technologies (AIRJ) is back in focus after deploying an AirJoule Core atmospheric water generation system at GE Vernova’s new Advanced Research Center in New York, where it will function as a live customer showcase. See our latest analysis for AirJoule Technologies. The GE Vernova showcase comes at a time when AirJoule Technologies’ share price has seen a 27.33% 7 day return and a 57.46% 90 day return, although the 3 year total shareholder return is down 46.61%.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
